caseNameFull: Tampa-Inter-Ocean Steamship Company, Inc. v. State of Louisiana
attorneys: Mr. George H. Terriberry, with whom Mr. W. W. Young, Mr. Joseph M. Rault, and Mr. Walter Carroll were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. Edward M. Heath, with whom Mr. J. Z. Spearing and Mr. C. C. Friederichs were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with costs, upon the authority of Texas Transport & Terminal Co. v. New Orleans, 264 U. S. 150.
